We believe privacy is a fundamental huma: We believe privacy is a fundamental human right. HOP services are designed from the ground up to minimize data collection, prevent surveillance, and never monetize user information.

For your account security, we maintain a: For your account security, we maintain a rolling log of your last 5 sign-ins (timestamp, IP address, device type, and approximate country/city) so you can audit access and detect unauthorized logins. This sign-in history is automatically purged after 90 days.
We store short-link slugs, destination U: We store short-link slugs, destination URLs, and optional link protection passwords. Click analytics record the time, country and city, network provider, device and browser type, and the referring site. We keep a keyed hash of each visitor's IP address, never the address itself, plus a daily visitor hash that changes every day at 00:00 UTC, so a visitor cannot be followed from one day to the next. Link creators never see visitor IP addresses.
We store bio page layout blocks, links,: We store bio page layout blocks, links, text, and user-uploaded media (avatars, banners). A bio page owner can add a tracking pixel (Google Analytics, Meta or TikTok). The page owner chooses to add it and is responsible for it; HOP only provides the platform. The pixel loads only after the visitor agrees. When it loads, the visitor's browser sends data to that service under its own privacy policy. HOP does not receive or process that data.
PixelHop stores the files you upload. Wh: PixelHop stores the files you upload. When you upload them, photos (JPEG, PNG and WebP) and videos lose their embedded metadata, including GPS location, camera make, model and serial number, and device details. PDFs are compressed, but their document properties are kept, so remove personal details from a PDF before you upload it.

For privacy questions, data requests, or: For privacy questions, data requests, or compliance inquiries:
HOP checks for malware, phishing and ill: HOP checks for malware, phishing and illegal material, for safety only: destination links in LinkHop, uploaded files in PixelHop, and content that someone reports, such as bio pages and basic notes. Confirmed harmful or illegal content is blocked. Encrypted notes cannot be inspected, because the server cannot read them.
Encrypted notes (the default) and their: Encrypted notes (the default) and their attachments are encrypted in your browser with AES-GCM before anything is sent over the network. The server only receives ciphertext; the key stays in the URL fragment (#k=...) and is never sent to the server. A basic note is not encrypted this way: the server can read it. An encrypted note can be read only by people who have the full link, including the part after #. Share the link only with the people you want to read it.
